name: Oust
summary:
UPDATE 0.2.0 - Fight Grukthar the troll and steal the mysterious relic that lies behind the guarded doors...

As you begin your journey, you will find yourself transported to a dungeon of stone corridors, caves of no end, and shadows that seem to whisper. Equipped with your choice of weaponry, you embark on a perilous quest to uncover the dungeon's secrets and confront its dark inhabitants - but most importantly, escape.
